description:
List the human's own Dueback negotiation cases (newest first):
case_id, status, public bill-type label, counterparty, and amounts
for each. Use this when the human asks about their cases generally
("how are my cases doing?") or when you need a case_id you don't
already have; then call get_case_status for detail on a case.
name: list_my_cases
title: List my cases
